lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jam kaa da(n)d moo(n)d mahi laagai khin mahi karai niberaa ||3||
lines.translation: When the Messenger of Death strikes him with his club, in an instant, everything is settled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan ootam bhagat sadaavai aagiaa man sukh paaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servant is called the most exalted Saint; he obeys the Command of the Lord's Order, and obtains peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sat kar maanai bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaaee ||4||
lines.translation: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord, he accepts as True; he enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu meree meree jhoothee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - it is false to call out, "Mine, mine."

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰਗਟ ਫਾਰਿ ਚਟਾਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਓ ਤਰੀ ਤਾਗਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੫॥੩॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: chiragat phaar chataaraa lai gaio taree taagaree chhootee ||5||3||16||
lines.translation: Breaking the bird cage, death takes the bird away, and only the torn threads remain. ||5||3||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham masakeen khudaaee ba(n)de tum raajas man bhaavai ||
lines.translation: I am Your humble servant, Lord; Your Praises are pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: alah aval deen ko saahib jor nahee phuramaavai ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Primal Being, the Master of the poor, does not ordain that they should be oppressed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਬਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaajee boliaa ban nahee aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Qazi, it is not right to speak before Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rojaa dharai nivaaj gujaarai kalamaa bhisat na hoee ||
lines.translation: Keeping your fasts, reciting your prayers, and reading the Kalma, the Islamic creed, shall not take you to paradise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾਬਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satar kaabaa ghat hee bheetar je kar jaanai koee ||2||
lines.translation: The Temple of Mecca is hidden within your mind, if you only knew it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਨਿਆਉ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਅਕਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nivaaj soee jo niaau bichaarai kalamaa akalahi jaanai ||
lines.translation: That should be your prayer, to administer justice. Let your Kalma be the knowledge of the unknowable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਚਹੁ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਤਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paachahu mus musalaa bichhaavai tab tau deen pachhaanai ||3||
lines.translation: Spread your prayer mat by conquering your five desires, and you shall recognize the true religion. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ਤਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasam pachhaan taras kar jee mahi maar manee kar pheekee ||
lines.translation: Recognize Your Lord and Master, and fear Him within your heart; conquer your egotism, and make it worthless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਜਨਾਇ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਿਸਤ ਸਰੀਕੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aap janaai avar kau jaanai tab hoi bhisat sareekee ||4||
lines.translation: As you see yourself, see others as well; only then will you become a partner in heaven. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਭੇਖ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maatee ek bhekh dhar naanaa taa mahi braham pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: The clay is one, but it has taken many forms; I recognize the One Lord within them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਭਿਸਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੪॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeeraa bhisat chhod kar dojak siu man maanaa ||5||4||17||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have abandoned paradise, and reconciled my mind to hell. ||5||4||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਬਰਖੈ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gagan nagar ik boo(n)d na barakhai naad kahaa j samaanaa ||
lines.translation: From the city of the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, not even a drop rains down. Where is the music of the sound current of the Naad, which was contained in it?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਲੇ ਸਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham paramesur maadho param ha(n)s le sidhaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Master of wealth has taken away the Supreme Soul. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਗਏ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa bolate te kahaa gae dehee ke sa(n)g rahate ||
lines.translation: O Father, tell me: where has it gone? It used to dwell within the body,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਤੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਥਾ ਬਾਰਤਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat maahi jo nirate karate kathaa baarataa kahate ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and dance in the mind, teaching and speaking. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bajaavanahaaro kahaa gaio jin ihu ma(n)dar keenhaa ||
lines.translation: Where has the player gone - he who made this temple his own?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਖੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਲੀਨੑਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saakhee sabad surat nahee upajai khi(n)ch tej sabh leenhaa ||2||
lines.translation: No story, word or understanding is produced; the Lord has drained off all the power. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sravanan bikal bhae sa(n)g tere i(n)dree kaa bal thaakaa ||
lines.translation: The ears, your companions, have gone deaf, and the power of your organs is exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਢਰਕਿ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan rahe kar dharak pare hai mukhahu na nikasai baataa ||3||
lines.translation: Your feet have failed, your hands have gone limp, and no words issue forth from your mouth. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭ ਤਸਕਰ ਆਪ ਆਪਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaake pa(n)ch doot sabh tasakar aap aapanai bhramate ||
lines.translation: Having grown weary, the five enemies and all the thieves have wandered away according to their own will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਉਰੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਧਰਿ ਰਮਤੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: thaakaa man ku(n)char ur thaakaa tej soot dhar ramate ||4||
lines.translation: The elephant of the mind has grown weary, and the heart has grown weary as well; through its power, it used to pull the strings. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਭਏ ਦਸੈ ਬੰਦ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: miratak bhae dasai ba(n)d chhoote mitr bhaaee sabh chhore ||
lines.translation: He is dead, and the bonds of the ten gates are opened; he has left all his friends and brothers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeeraa jo har dhiaavai jeevat ba(n)dhan tore ||5||5||18||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, one who meditates on the Lord, breaks his bonds, even while yet alive. ||5||5||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ikatuke 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, 4 Ek-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarapanee te oopar nahee baleeaa ||
lines.translation: No one is more powerful than the she-serpent Maya,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin brahamaa bisan mahaadeu chhaleeaa ||1||
lines.translation: who deceived even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਪੈਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maar maar srapanee niramal jal paithee ||
lines.translation: Having bitten and struck them down, she now sits in the immaculate waters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਡਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin tribhavan daseeale gur prasaad deethee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have seen her, who has bitten the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: srapanee srapanee kiaa kahahu bhaaee ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, why is she called a she-serpent?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin saach pachhaaniaa tin srapanee khaaee ||2||
lines.translation: One who realizes the True Lord, devours the she-serpent. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਆਨ ਛੂਛ ਨਹੀ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: srapanee te aan chhoochh nahee avaraa ||
lines.translation: No one else is more frivolous than this she-serpent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਜੀਤੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: srapanee jeetee kahaa karai jamaraa ||3||
lines.translation: When the she-serpent is overcome, what can the Messengers of the King of Death do? ||3||
